about: Rendered examples (docs/design/engine-site.md, section 7). Each entry names a fenced ts block by file and index (as docs/validation/documentation-fragments.json counts them) and the binding that holds the result. The build runs the block unchanged with the engine built from the same commit and shows the engine's own pixels. `home` puts the picture on the home page as well.

examples.name: color-patches-display-view
examples.homeLink: Color patches: the code for this picture
examples.alt: The 30 color patches in six columns and five rows on a gray background: six neutral grays from near white to near black in the top row, then saturated and muted colors, skin tones, foliage, sky blue, orange and violet.

examples.name: layered-scenes-using-it
examples.alt: Five white cards in a staircase, marked 976, 990, 1000, 1010 and 1025, each with a Siemens star, in front of a gray back plane with small colored point lights. The star on the card marked 1000 is the sharpest; the stars on the nearest and farthest cards are blurred. The star centers show false patterns and colored fringes.
